source_notes: Mapping was checked against the live Mochi Experience record and Vimeo player metadata on 2026-08-14.
This file is public-safe routing metadata. It intentionally excludes Vimeo embed hashes, expiring playback URLs, download URLs, credentials, and private connector state.
Live Experience HTML remains the source of truth for the rendered card. This mapping is for agents deciding which video belongs with which slot.

vimeo_folders.name: 00 Welcome
vimeo_folders.purpose: Landing area for polished welcome videos that introduce GreatVibe to new users.

vimeo_folders.name: 10 Using Mochi
vimeo_folders.purpose: Practical videos about using Mochi, inspecting a node, starting work, and asking for help.

vimeo_folders.name: 20 Turns And Review
vimeo_folders.purpose: Videos about gvturn cards, review states, power footer actions, audits, and delivery status.

vimeo_folders.name: 30 Credentials And Connectors
vimeo_folders.purpose: Credential, connector, and API access walkthroughs.

vimeo_folders.name: 40 Building With AI
vimeo_folders.purpose: Videos about using AI agents as part of a professional engineering workflow.

vimeo_folders.name: 90 Tests And Archive
vimeo_folders.purpose: Archive for tests, aspect-ratio checks, and videos that should not be suggested for onboarding.

vimeo_folders.name: JohnathonQuickVids
vimeo_folders.purpose: Legacy active folder currently holding the two catalogue videos used by Mochi Experiences.

mochi_experience_slots.use_when: Give a new user a comprehensive GreatVibe walkthrough before their first serious Mochi request.
mochi_experience_slots.notes: Version 8 is live with the square Johnathon Intro to greatVibe recording; the private Vimeo embed hash remains only in the Experience record.

mochi_experience_slots.use_when: Show returning users a richer update about recent Mochi, gvturn, node, and platform workflow improvements.
mochi_experience_slots.notes: This is currently a broad walkthrough. Replace it with a tighter release-update video when a dedicated recording exists.

placement_rules: Prefer `00 Welcome` for short first-login orientation videos once a polished replacement is ready.
Prefer `10 Using Mochi` for task and node walkthroughs that help users start work.
Prefer `20 Turns And Review` for gvturn, status, audit, and power footer videos.
Prefer `30 Credentials And Connectors` for credential, connector, and external API setup videos.
Prefer `40 Building With AI` for engineering workflow, planning, review, and build-process videos.
Keep test clips, aspect-ratio checks, and obsolete recordings in `90 Tests And Archive` and do not suggest them in Mochi Experiences.
Do not move an existing video that is embedded in an active Mochi Experience unless the Experience render path has been rechecked afterwards.
